props.name: config
props.description: The config parameter pertains to the form configuration, which is the object returned when you invoke the 'useForm()' function.

props.name: ref
props.description: The ref parameter corresponds to the reference of the form field. It's important to define and pass this reference to your custom field component.

props.name: type
props.description: The RFM input type or validation pattern you intend to apply to the field.
